# Sajda 4.5.0
### Mosque timetables are now offline files Prayer times from your mosque are now imported as files — an annual PDF calendar, a ZIP of monthly CSVs, or individual CSVs — and stored on your Mac. They work fully offline: no lookups, no downloads, no accounts. Manage them in Settings > Mosque Timetable.
### Fix: CSV timetables without iqama left an empty gap Timetables that publish only adhan times reserved the iqama column anyway, so every clock sat a column away from the right edge with nothing in the gap. The column is now reserved only when the timetable actually publishes an iqama gap for today.
### Fix: February spillover rows counted twice Some monthly exports append March 1 as a 29th February row. That copy is now dropped, so February 28 is followed by March 1 with no duplicate day.
